# Trip Comfort: Motion Sickness

> Trip Comfort is a drug-free motion sickness app for Apple Watch and iPhone. Try a wrist pulse, paced breathing, a 100 Hz tone or a timed hold. Free.

## App

- [Trip Comfort: Motion Sickness App for Apple Watch](https://jackwallner.com/ios/queasy/index.html.md): Trip Comfort is a drug-free motion sickness app for Apple Watch and iPhone. Try a wrist pulse, paced breathing, a 100 Hz tone or a timed hold. Free.

- [Best Motion Sickness App for iPhone (2026)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/queasy/best-motion-sickness-app.html.md): Motion sickness apps for iPhone and Apple Watch compared: Apple's Vehicle Motion Cues, RideCalm, Dizzout, Hearapy and Trip Comfort, with what each one does.
